nodes.title: 2 - TURNAROUND SHEET - generated once, wired to all four crops
1 - APPROVED IMAGE - only manual image input
Qwen turnaround instruction - published prompt unchanged
widgets_values: Turn the character in <image1> into an orthographic 3D modeling reference sheet: a single horizontal row of four equal-width panels, evenly spaced. From left to right: 1) front view. 2) left side view, an exact 90° profile, snout pointing to the left edge of the image, only one eye visible, the near arm pointing straight at the camera and strongly foreshortened, the far arm hidden behind the body. 3) back view, exactly 180°. 4) right side view, an exact 90° profile, snout pointing to the right edge of the image, only one eye visible, near arm foreshortened toward the camera, far arm hidden. The camera orbits a completely static character: same T-pose and same head direction in every view, the character never turns toward the camera. Identical outfit, colors, proportions and scale in all views, each character centered in its panel, feet on the same baseline, no overlap between views. Flat, even lighting, solid black background, no text, no labels.

ASSET PIPELINE — test and export
widgets_values: Image references → four cardinal views → fully decoded Pixal3D mesh → Hi3D refinement → measured cleanup → final-geometry TRELLIS.2 textures. Use the Foundry interface to provide your own images and choose exports. The preserved master is retained before reduction.

nodes.title: 11 — Finishing source: saved mesh / live pipeline
OPTIONAL QUADS — qualified 25K preset / UV + bake + export
12 — ASSET PACKAGE: selected exports + directory README + ZIP
FINISHING — optional editable quads, preserved originals
widgets_values: Optional quad retopology, UV/detail baking and selected exports. BLEND, OBJ and authoring FBX preserve polygon faces; runtime GLB/FBX are triangulated. Quads do not imply a rig or deformation-ready animation topology. Print exports include measurements; physical print suitability needs a separate check.
